title: Jets fans keep their rookie expectations reasonable for David Bailey

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets fans keep their rookie expectations reasonable for David Bailey
sources.description: The number two overall pick in the NFL Draft always enters the league with his fanbase expecting big things his rookie year. Jets fans are excited to have David Bailey. The hope is that he eventually turns into a transformational player for the defense and becomes a standout pass rusher. What are the expectations for […]
